qrel_policy.path_match: exact repo-relative file for automatic qrel lookup; unjudged paths are unknown, not irrelevant

target_snapshot_note: HEAD plus working tree inspected; pre-existing dirty staging tfvars and untracked .pi/docs audit paths were not used as qrels. Every judged file has its own content hash.
